priorityList: Use Mind Freeze to interrupt spellcasting.
Cast Reaper's Mark when Pillar of Frost is nearly ready to ensure they overlap.
Cast Pillar of Frost if Reaper's Mark is active or if Reaper's Mark will not be available for at least 10 seconds.
Use Breath of Sindragosa during Pillar of Frost if you have at least 60 Runic Power.
Cast Remorseless Winter on cooldown if talented into Gathering Storm.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury during Pillar of Frost, but only if Reaper's Mark is not currently active on the target.
Use Raise Dead on cooldown and Empower Rune Weapon if you are low on Runes or Runic Power.
Use offensive trinkets and potions specifically during your Pillar of Frost window.
Cast Obliterate if you have 2 stacks of Killing Machine or if you have 1 stack and at least 3 Runes.
Cast Howling Blast if Rime is active and you have the Frostbound Will talent.
Cast Frost Strike if Shattering Blade is talented and the target has 5 stacks of Razorice.
Cast Howling Blast on any Rime proc.
Cast Frost Strike if Runic Power is nearly capped (deficit less than 30).
Cast Obliterate on any remaining Killing Machine procs.
Cast Frost Strike to spend Runic Power and Obliterate as your primary Rune spender.
